about.hero.title: Built for the Road. Engineered for Trust.
about.hero.subtitle: From our Quebec headquarters, we supply Canada's fleets with the heavy-duty brake and suspension parts they depend on — every day.
about.story.label: Our Story
about.story.title: From Industry Veterans to Industry Leaders
about.story.p1: REMQUIP was founded in 2025 by a team of heavy-duty parts industry veterans who saw an opportunity to modernize parts distribution in Canada. With decades of combined experience in fleet management, aftermarket distribution, and logistics, we set out to build something better.
about.story.p2: Based in Quebec City, we started with a clear mission: provide Canadian fleets and distributors with reliable access to premium brake and suspension components — faster, with better service, and at competitive prices.
about.story.p3: Today, REMQUIP serves hundreds of businesses across Canada, maintaining over 500 SKUs in stock across three strategic warehouse locations to ensure 48-hour delivery nationwide.

about.values.title: What Drives Us Every Day
about.value.quality.title: Uncompromising Quality
about.value.quality.desc: Every part we sell is tested to meet or exceed OEM standards. We stand behind our products with comprehensive warranties.
about.value.speed.title: Speed & Reliability
about.value.speed.desc: With three strategically located warehouses, we deliver within 48 hours anywhere in Canada. No delays, no excuses.
about.value.partnership.title: True Partnership
about.value.partnership.desc: We build lasting relationships with our customers. Dedicated account managers, flexible payment terms, and priority support.
about.value.reach.title: National Reach
about.value.reach.desc: From coast to coast, our distribution network ensures every Canadian fleet has access to the parts they need.

about.milestone.foundation.desc: REMQUIP was built around dependable inventory, disciplined operations, and a clear focus on the heavy-duty parts market.
about.milestone.distribution.desc: We continue to strengthen our distribution capabilities to improve delivery performance and support customer demand at scale.

legal.terms.content:

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.content:
Last updated: 2026. REMQUIP ("we", "us", "our") operates https://www.remquip.ca and the associated REMQUIP commerce platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website, create an account, place an order or otherwise interact with our services.

1. Information we collect. We collect information you provide directly, including your name, business name, billing and shipping addresses, email address, telephone number, payment information, account credentials and any communications you send us. We also automatically collect technical information such as IP address, browser type, device identifiers, pages visited and referring URLs through cookies and similar technologies.

2. How we use your information. We use your personal information to process and ship orders, manage your account, provide customer support, send transactional emails and receipts, prevent fraud, comply with legal obligations and improve our products and services. With your consent, we may also send marketing communications, which you can opt out of at any time.

3. Third-party services and integrations. We share limited personal information with trusted third-party service providers strictly to operate our business, including: payment processors (such as Stripe) to process transactions; accounting and invoicing platforms (such as Intuit QuickBooks Online) to sync customers, invoices and payments; email and SMS providers to deliver transactional and marketing communications; shipping carriers to deliver your orders; and analytics providers to understand site usage. These providers are contractually required to protect your information and use it only for the services they perform on our behalf.

4. QuickBooks Online integration. When the REMQUIP platform is connected to QuickBooks Online, customer, invoice, payment and product data may be transmitted to and from Intuit's services to keep accounting records in sync. Intuit's handling of this data is governed by Intuit's own privacy policy.

5. Cookies. We use cookies and similar technologies for authentication, cart persistence, language and currency preferences, security and analytics. You may disable cookies through your browser; some site features may not function correctly without them.

6. Data retention. We retain personal information only as long as needed to provide our services and to satisfy our legal, accounting and tax obligations under Canadian law (including the Province of Quebec).

7. Security. We implement industry-standard administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction. No internet transmission is 100% secure, but we work continuously to protect your data.

8. Your rights. Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information; withdraw consent to marketing; or lodge a complaint with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.

9. International transfers. Some of our service providers may store or process information outside Canada (including in the United States). Where this occurs, we use contractual safeguards to ensure your information receives an equivalent level of protection.

10. Changes to this policy. We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "last updated" date will indicate when changes take effect. Material changes will be communicated through the website or by email.

11. Contact us. For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, contact us at info@remquip.ca or by mail at REMQUIP, Quebec City, QC, Canada.
legal.shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
legal.shipping.content:
REMQUIP ships across Canada and to select US destinations. Standard shipping is calculated at checkout based on weight and destination.

Orders over C$500 qualify for free shipping within Canada. Most orders ship within 1-2 business days from our Quebec warehouse.

Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused products in original packaging. A restocking fee of 15% may apply. Defective products are replaced at no charge.
legal.refund.title: Refund Policy
legal.refund.content:
Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after we receive the returned product. Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

Custom orders and special-order items are non-refundable. Shipping costs are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.
legal.cookie.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookie.content:
REMQUIP uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences.

We use essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies to understand how visitors use our site. You can control cookie settings through your browser.

legal.about.title: About REMQUIP
legal.about.content:
REMQUIP is Canada's next-generation heavy-duty parts distributor, based in Quebec City and serving fleets, distributors, and OEMs nationwide since 2025.

We specialize in heavy-duty brakes and air suspension components for commercial trucks and trailers. Our commitment to quality, competitive pricing, and fast shipping sets us apart.

With 15+ years of combined industry experience, our team understands the demands of the heavy-duty transportation industry and delivers the parts you need, when you need them.
